meta.description: Sensitive guide to marriage-delay mantras — Durga, Venkateswara, Rahu/Ketu japa in Japam.

blocks.text: Mantra Practice When Marriage Is Delayed

runs.text: Delayed marriage causes family worry. Traditions suggest patient japa to Durga, Katyayani, Venkateswara, or graha shanti — never coercion or fear.
Japam supports daily japa; matchmaking and astrology need human counsel.
Chant for inner peace and trust in divine timing — not to control another person. Consult elders and astrologers for chart-specific advice.

items: Rahu/Ketu japa when nodes affect chart (astrologer-guided)
Choose one deity focus per vow — avoid mixing without guidance
Chant 108 daily for 21 or 41 days if that is your sankalpa
Visit temple when possible; home lamp and flower suffice

runs.text: Friday Lakshmi, Tuesday Durga, or astrologer-prescribed graha day.
Try Durga, Venkateswara, or graha modes in Japam — educational support only.

faqs.question: Which mantra is best?
faqs.answer: Depends on chart and tradition — Katyayani, Venkateswara, and Durga are common; ask your priest.

faqs.question: Will japa guarantee marriage by a date?
faqs.answer: No — Japam does not promise outcomes; practice is for devotion and peace.

faqs.question: Mangal dosha?
faqs.answer: Astrologers assess; japa may be one part of remedies alongside charity and puja.

faqs.question: Can parents chant for children?
faqs.answer: Yes — many parents vow japa for children’s wellbeing.

faqs.question: Rahu/Ketu for marriage?
faqs.answer: Sometimes recommended — only with qualified Jyotisha advice.

disclaimer.text: This article is for educational and devotional practice only. Japam does not provide medical, legal, or financial advice.
